name: Notion

surfaces.surface_type: main-window (AI meeting-note view), marketing perspective render
failures: #9 tertiary gray labels ('View all', '@Today' mention) ~3-3.5:1 on white, below 4.5:1 (estimated, perspective+JPEG)
#10 mid-gray line icons ~3:1 borderline vs white
native#3 selection is flat gray fill but text neutral, not accent-tinted
native#5 web ~15-16px body and generous rows, not 13pt/24-28pt native ladder
native#6 no system-accent binding anywhere; color reserved for status/identity only
native#10 traffic lights rendered monochrome grey (inactive or custom, not the colored cluster)

tokens.value: #FFFFFF pure white, sidebar+content identical (no tonal elevation)

tokens.notes: sidebar rows; not 13pt macOS body — density tell
monochrome by design; the strongest signature
'Stop' record button — the only saturated action in view

tokens.value: flat light-gray rounded fill ~8-10px radius, neutral text
tokens.notes: 'Home' row and 'Notes' tab share one grammar
inactive-window render or custom; real Electron frame

patterns.key_values: left source list, full-height, same pure white as content (no vibrancy); selected 'Home' in gray pill + a horizontal icon strip (chat/calendar/inbox/search) = web pattern, not native vertical list; labeled sentence-case sections (Meetings, Teamspaces); generous web-density rows
in-content sub-toolbar, not window chrome: three-item tab group (Summary/Notes-selected/Transcript, icon+label) + audio waveform + pause + tinted-red Stop + overflow; document-scoped AI recording bar
sidebar rows = leading monochrome line-icon + label; secondary rows in gray; hierarchy via de-emphasis not size
content top-right cluster: timestamp + stacked collaborator avatars + Share text button + comment + star + overflow

signature_moves: Grayscale-except-for-meaning: entire UI is monochrome; system accent refused; color appears only where it means something (red=recording, blue=Company OS, avatar rings=identity) — Von Restorff enforced at system level so the one red control cannot be missed

Platform-material erasure as document-first ideology: sidebar and canvas share one pure white, no vibrancy/glass/tonal elevation; the blank page IS the aesthetic and the OS is made to vanish — consistent cross-platform canvas over native fidelity
Hand-drawn black-and-white character illustrations (with colored rings) supply the only warmth against an otherwise Swiss-neutral surface
defects: Contrast Dilution (mild) — lightest tertiary labels ('View all', '@Today' mention) ~3-3.5:1 on white and mid-gray icons ~3:1, at/below WCAG floors (estimated, perspective+JPEG)
Accent-binding absence (lineage tell) — selection/nav neutral gray, no controlAccentColor; native correction: tint selection+focus+primary to system accent
Non-native sidebar icon strip (lineage tell) — horizontal chat/calendar/inbox/search row in the source-list header is a web pattern
Web density (lineage tell) — ~15-16px body and tall rows vs 13pt/24-28pt macOS 27 ladder

aesthetic.direction: Utilitarian-humanist monochrome workspace — Swiss/International structure (near-white ground, near-black ink, one color reserved for meaning) blended with humanist-sans + hand-drawn illustration warmth; a neo-grotesque product look stripped of the electric accent

psychology: Von Restorff effect — the single tinted-red Stop is the one different thing in an all-gray field, so the eye locks onto the live recording control
Hierarchy via de-emphasis (processing fluency) — secondary/tertiary text pushed to gray while primary stays black; hierarchy survives entirely in grayscale
Jakob's Law — adopts the familiar web sidebar+content document convention, trading native surprise for cross-app predictability
Miller/Cowan chunking — sidebar grouped into short labeled sections (Meetings, Teamspaces), few items each
Aesthetic-usability / low perceptual load — the calm monochrome canvas minimizes extraneous visual noise
notes: ONLY inputs were a marketing cover (composite: white backdrop, Notion wordmark + block icon, headline 'Where teams and agents [Think] together' with a branded light-blue pill, a row of illustrated persona avatars) and the app icon; no dedicated UI screenshots. The single app surface is composited into the cover in 3D PERSPECTIVE (rotated, receding) — not axis-aligned, so no clean pixel measurement or retina scale is recoverable; all metrics are (estimated) with wide ranges, JPEG-softened, many rubric checks N/A for lack of surface content (no forms, paragraphs, focus states, settings/empty/dark surfaces). Lineage web-electron is publicly known and tell-corroborated; this app feeds CONTRAST evidence only and must not enter macOS canon or native clusters. App icon (context, not digested as icon workflow): the classic monochrome isometric 'N' block — reinforces the same grayscale brand discipline seen in the UI. Cover headline/pill/avatars are brand evidence, distinct from the app-window design evidence.
